## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2016-06-09: WL Ross / Nexeo business combination closes; PubCo renamed Nexeo Solutions, Inc.; TRA executed with TPG-affiliated TRA Holders (TPG VI Neon II, TPG VI FOF Neon, Nexeo Holdco, plus assignee TPG VI Neon I via the Blocker Merger); 85% sharing of net realized tax benefits from Holdings LLC Merger basis step-ups, pre-existing Nexeo attributes, TPG Accolade Blocker NOLs, and imputed interest; 8-K files executed TRA and Form of Joinder

#### Univar acquisition and negotiated termination

- 2018-09-17: Univar merger agreement signed; concurrent Tax Receivable Termination and Settlement Agreement substitutes a negotiated $60.0M payment for the contract's Section 4.01 Early Termination formula, conditional on merger close
- 2019-03-01: Univar merger closes; TRA terminates in its entirety, $60.0M paid (net of pre-closing payments)

## Explanation

Nexeo Solutions, Inc. (formerly WL Ross Holding Corp.) emerged from a June 9, 2016 SPAC business combination with Nexeo Solutions Holdings, LLC and executed a Tax Receivable Agreement obligating PubCo to pay 85% of net realized tax benefits from the Holdings LLC Merger basis step-ups, the pre-existing Nexeo LLC tax attributes, the NOLs of the TPG Accolade Blocker inherited via the Blocker Merger, and imputed interest, to TPG-affiliated beneficiaries. The contract was not amended during its life. Univar Inc. agreed to acquire Nexeo on September 17, 2018, and a concurrent Tax Receivable Termination and Settlement Agreement substituted a negotiated $60.0M payment for the contract's Section 4.01 Early Termination formula, conditional on the merger close (approximately 84% of the $71.1M fair value liability at year-end 2018). The merger closed March 1, 2019 and the TRA was fully extinguished; $10.2M in cash had been paid to TPG during FY 2018 prior to the termination, netting down against the $60.0M closing payment. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
